shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin (BTC) consolidated around $81,500, and Ethereum (ETH) traded near $2,400, showing mixed signals.
US CPI (3.7%) and PPI (6.3%) inflation came in hotter than expected, increasing Federal Reserve rate hike odds.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index dropped from 63 to 55, indicating cooling optimism in the market.
US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs recorded combined net outflows of approximately $549 million this week.
The European Central Bank (ECB) confirmed plans for a digital euro pilot in late 2027, targeting legislation by end of 2026.
